description: This file defines the ClaimRequest class, an ORM entity representing claim request records in the database for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes properties like employee info, user info, claim event, status, and timestamps, along with ORM mappings and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ClaimRequest
classes.description: ORM entity class representing a claim request, including relationships to employee, user, claim event, and currency, as well as status and timestamp properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the claim request.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this claim request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this claim request.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the User who added the claim request.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the User who added the claim request.

methods.name: getReferenceId
methods.description: Returns the reference ID of the claim request.

methods.name: setReferenceId
methods.description: Sets the reference ID of the claim request.

methods.name: getClaimEvent
methods.description: Returns the ClaimEvent associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setClaimEvent
methods.description: Sets the ClaimEvent for the claim request.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the optional description of the claim request.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the claim request.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType associated with the claim request.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType for the claim request.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the claim request is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setIsDeleted
methods.description: Marks the claim request as deleted or not.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the claim request.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the claim request.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the claim request.

methods.name: setCreatedDate
methods.description: Sets the creation date of the claim request.

methods.name: getSubmittedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the claim request was submitted, if any.

methods.name: setSubmittedDate
methods.description: Sets the submitted date of the claim request.
